description: This file defines an interface AuthParamsInterface within the OrangeHRM authentication DTO namespace. It specifies method signatures for accessing user credentials and authentication attributes, serving as a contract for implementing classes related to authentication parameters.

classes.name: AuthParamsInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods to retrieve user credentials and authentication attribute bags.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Returns the user credential object or null if not available.

methods.name: getAttributeBag
methods.description: Returns the authentication attribute bag object or null if not available.
